takeaways: The unused Block #3/#4 verticals are the best untapped material: Cold Plunge Vertical, Group Training Vertical, Train and Recovery Vertical and Team Work 1 Vertical (all 4). They have richer color and real smiles, and they fit the hero loop's vertical side stacks, service:organic-social and blog:content-production-at-scale-gym. The golden-hour drone orbit (Exterior Shot Landscape, 3) would make a good establishing shot for the work/iron-24 page. For hero shots, use the clean variants: Cold Plunge no text no logo at 0:04 and Cardio and Workout no logo at 0:10 box jump. Keep the SAM whiteboard talking heads and the Pails and Rails timer videos off the site, and replace Ankle Strap on services/influencer-marketing: it is a static mobility demo, not influencer work.
